newsitem.title: USA: Volunteer Capital sees pretax earning drop.
newsitem.headline: Volunteer Capital sees pretax earning drop.

text.p: Volunteer Capital Corp said Wednesday it expects fourth quarter pre-tax earnings will be reduced by about $500,000 because it will shorten the amortization period for pre-opening costs of new J. Alexander's restaurants.
R. Gregory Lewis, the company's chief financial officer, declined to comment on the impact on fourth quarter and year-end results.
First Call consensus earnings estimates for the company are $0.03 per share for the fourth quarter and $0.28 for the 1996 year.
Earlier Wednesday Volunteer Capital reported third quarter earnings of $0.07 per share, down from $0.18 in the year-ago period. First Call estimate for third quarter earnings were $0.10 per share.
At 1226 EDT, Volunteer Capital shares were trading down 1/8 at 8-1/2.

The company said it will cut the amortization period for pre-opening costs on new J. Alexander's restaurants from 24 to 12 months in the fourth quarter if the Securities and Exchange Commission does not object.
The company operates 56 Wendy's Old Fashioned Hamburgers restaurants in four states and 13 J. Alexander's restaurants in seven states.
